title: feat: retire manual community-model hiding
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the manual hide/unhide toggle and API; owners use Private instead.
- Shows reliability-filtered Public models and their recent success rate in My Models.
- Keeps saved prices, Paid Pollen setting, and fallbacks through Private, while Private calls remain free.
- Migrates manually hidden rows to Private without losing queued configuration or historical hide metadata. Monitor-hidden rows stay Public under the reliability rule.
- Updates monitor instructions and tests. Apply D1 migration 0067 before deploying Gen/Enter to production.

gist.headline: One less switch to tend
gist.blurb: Community models get a simpler choice: Public or Private. My Models also makes it easier to see how reliably Public models are running.
gist.summary: Community models replace manual hide/unhide controls and their API with Private; My Models shows reliability-filtered Public models and recent success rates, while previously hidden models move to Private with their saved prices, Paid Pollen settings, fallbacks, and hide history preserved.
gist.impact: Owners can use Private instead of a separate hide toggle without losing queued configuration; Private calls remain free, and Public listings follow the reliability rule.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy model garden with distinct Public and Private flower pots rather than a hide switch. Polli tends the Private pot while a small CRT robot reads a recent success-rate display beside the Public pot; preserved configuration appears as neatly stacked seed packets.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel-art model garden, Polli in a tiny gardener's hat tends a lime green (#ecf874) Private flower pot while a friendly CRT robot checks a simple success-rate display beside a Public pot and neatly stacked seed packets. Polli is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium within the scene, with consistent rounded proportions, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients over warm cream, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, emotionally warm.
